description: Create or replace a remote Streamable HTTP or legacy SSE MCP server configuration at the user's request. The saved server is disabled; this tool never connects or authenticates.

propertyDescriptions.transport: http for Streamable HTTP or sse for a legacy SSE endpoint.
propertyDescriptions.url: Remote MCP endpoint. HTTPS required except loopback HTTP; no credentials, query string, or fragment.
propertyDescriptions.auth: Remote authentication: none, bearer from an environment variable, or OAuth through the user's /mcp flow.
propertyDescriptions.bearerTokenEnvVar: Name of the environment variable containing a bearer token; never provide the token value.

guidance: Only save MCP configuration when the user explicitly asks. Never put secret values in the URL or configuration. The user must separately authenticate, enable, and approve the connection in /mcp.
